name: card-31
description: Weather widget card with current conditions and a five-day forecast row.

files.content:
import { CloudIcon, CloudRainIcon, CloudSunIcon, DropletsIcon, MapPinIcon, SunIcon, WindIcon, } from "lucide-react" import { Card, CardAction, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle, } from "@workspace/ui/components/card" const forecast = [ { day: "Tue", icon: SunIcon, high: 21, low: 12 }, { day: "Wed", icon: CloudSunIcon, high: 19, low: 11 }, { day: "Thu", icon: CloudRainIcon, high: 15, low: 9 }, { day: "Fri", icon: CloudIcon, high: 16, low: 10 }, { day: "Sat", icon: SunIcon, high: 22, low: 13 }, ] export default function WeatherForecastCard() { return ( Porto, Portugal 18° 14 km/h 62% {forecast.map((f) => (
{f.day} {f.high}° {f.low}°
))} ) }
